summary: Backend + Frontend E2E testing of NEW Carichi Magazzino feature. All 17 backend tests PASS (17/17), covering POST validation, stock increment, GET/filter, PUT delta math, DELETE rollback, photo replace, concurrency, real_quantity integration. Frontend happy-path fully works: Magazziniere login → home → Carico button → /magazzino/carichi → Nuovo Carico → supplier filters products → photo required (submit disabled) → +/- and keypad → submit → redirect to list → edit page (supplier disabled, pre-filled, photo preview) → delete with confirm rolls back stock. Found 2 minor UX issues (edit preview label misleading; Flaminio direct URL not redirected).

ui_bugs.issue: In edit mode the 'Stock attuale: N → Nuovo: N+qty' preview is misleading. Example: product already has current stock 111 (which includes old +12 from this same carico). Editing qty=12 shows 'Stock attuale: 111 → Nuovo: 123', but actual backend delta is 0 so stock stays at 111. Magazziniere could think saving will double-count. Suggestion: in edit mode, base the preview on (currentStock - oldItemQty + newItemQty) so the 'Nuovo' value reflects reality. Backend math itself is correct (verified by test_edit_qty_applies_delta_not_full_readd).

Locale user (Flaminio) can open /magazzino/carichi directly via URL. Backend correctly returns 403 (2x AxiosError in console), but UI does not show an error or redirect — page renders as 'Nessun carico trovato' with an active 'Nuovo carico merce' button. Should add a role guard on the route (redirect to /home) or render a 403 error state. Security is fine (backend enforces), only UX.

action_items: Fix edit-mode preview math in NuovoCaricoPage so 'Nuovo: N' reflects delta (currentStock - oldQty + newQty), not a naive add.
Add route-level role guard on /magazzino/carichi* to redirect non-magazzino/admin users (currently relies on backend 403 only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST/PUT/DELETE /carichi correctly handles the photo file lifecycle: create saves, update deletes old + saves new, delete removes file. No orphaned files observed.

PUT delta computation (lines ~1798-1811) uses a union of old and new product_ids and $inc per delta — correct for add/remove/modify cases. Duplicate product_id entries in the same carico are summed before delta — robust.
All 4 carico endpoints (POST/GET list/GET one/PUT/DELETE) have identical role check `role not in (magazzino, admin)`; DRY could be extracted but current explicit form is readable.
_serialize_carico strips _id and maps photo_file → photo_url: clean, no ObjectId leakage.

save_image_to_disk is sync file I/O called from async handlers (uses pathlib write_bytes). For small DDT photos this is acceptable, but under load it will block the event loop. Consider aiofiles or a thread executor if volumes grow.
server.py is now ~2040 lines. Recommend splitting magazzino (carichi + richieste + products + warehouse) into its own router module.
CaricoUpdate.items: None means 'no change', but if client sends [] it would pass validation then fail with 400 inside the handler — acceptable; consider explicit Pydantic validator.

No transactional guarantee across insert + multiple product $inc. If the process dies mid-loop, carico is created but stock partially updated. For single-pod deployments with MongoDB standalone this is a minor risk; a follow-up could wrap in a session transaction if MongoDB is replica-set.
Frontend NuovoCaricoPage: the keypad and +/- UX work cleanly; photo required enforcement is correct (submit disabled via isDisabled when !photoData && !isEdit).

success_rate.frontend: 95% — all core flows work; 2 minor UX issues (edit preview math, locale RBAC redirect)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created 2 products (TEST_Carico_Prod_A/B) with supplier TEST_Supplier_Carico and tore them down via DELETE /api/products/{id} after the suite. Frontend test created one carico on supplier Derrate (DDT-UITEST-001) with Pecorino +12; stock went 99→111→99 after deletion — CONFIRMED restored. No residue left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Carichi endpoints and NuovoCaricoPage/CarichiMagazzinoPage fully verified end-to-end. Stock math (create/edit-delta/delete-rollback) is correct at the backend layer. The only remaining polish items are UI-side: (1) edit preview shows misleading 'Nuovo' number because it double-counts the already-applied old carico; (2) no frontend route guard for locale users on /magazzino/carichi*. Backend RBAC is solid (403). Pesto/Pomodorella/Pecorino current stocks were not permanently modified.
